column3: Solution-style root tsconfig (11 lines): files:[] plus references to tsconfig.host.json and tsconfig.client.json, so one tsc -b builds both desktop halves in dependency order.

Electron main-process compile project: extends tsconfig.base.json, rootDir src / outDir lib/types, include [src] with exclude [src/client], and eight workspace project references (app-boot, home-paths, deepseek-account, api/gateway, ui-sidebar-browser, shortcuts, atomic-write, product-analytics).

Renderer/welcome compile project: extends tsconfig.base.client.json (react-jsx, DOM libs, no Node ambient types), include src/client plus the two shared modules src/welcome-api.ts and src/locale.ts, with three client-side project references.

Bundler config producing four artifact kinds: privileged command-manager bundle with an empty external-package allowlist, Electron main bundle, Vite-built welcome IIFE with copied Montserrat font assets, and five sandboxed CommonJS preload bundles with a four-module allowlist; only DSH_CLIENT_VERSION is inlined via define.

103-line Windows EV-signing and shared-runner runbook: trust/isolation limits, supervised signing preflight with a never-executed probe, timestamp retry rules, the persistent hardware-attempt interlock, the account-level stage lock, and the verified signature cache with a per-stage SIGNATURE_CACHE_SUMMARY.

Simplified-Chinese mirror of README.md with identical heading structure and anchors; identical operational content including the credential-withholding contract, with relative links retargeted to the .zh.md locale form.

43-line bilingual pairing consistency record: 14 heading-section key paths each carrying a 16-hex hash of the English and Chinese blocks (excluding fenced code and generated regions), regenerated by pnpm run verify-translation-pairing --write.
